message: The other day, I was cooking and almost set off the smoke alarm—again. As I scrambled to fan the smoke away, my family group chat lit up with advice and jokes about my culinary skills. It got me thinking about how important it is to have an escape plan that everyone knows, just in case. It’s a good reminder that safety can be a family affair, even when we’re just trying to make dinner. Have you shared your own escape plans lately?
